zh.title: 英國皇家空軍紅箭飛行表演隊受天候延誤 滯留加拿大並取消三場演出
zh.summary: 英國紅箭飛行表演隊因北大西洋惡劣天候滯留鵝灣，被迫取消三場英國演出。
body: 英國皇家空軍（RAF）紅箭飛行表演隊（Red Arrows）因北大西洋惡劣天候影嚮，滯留於加拿大拉布拉多的鵝灣（Goose Bay），導致團隊無法如期返回英國，並已取消三場原定在英國舉行的飛行表演活動。

受取消影嚮的活動包含8月14日與15日的伊斯特本國際航空展（Airbourne Eastbourne International Airshow）、8月15日於皇家愛丁堡軍樂節（Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo）的空中分列式，以及8月16日的萊姆里吉斯救生艇週（Lyme Regis Lifeboat Week）。皇家空軍特技飛行隊指揮官薩沙·納什（Sasha Nash）中校表示，安全是決定團隊從加拿大返回時間的唯一因素。

en.title: RAF Red Arrows Delayed in Canada by Weather, Cancelling Three UK Shows
en.summary: The RAF Red Arrows are stranded in Canada by Atlantic weather, cancelling three UK airshow appearances.
body: The Royal Air Force (RAF) Red Arrows aerobatic team has cancelled three scheduled UK appearances after becoming stranded in Goose Bay (YYR), Labrador, where poor weather has delayed their return flight across the North Atlantic following a deployment in North America.

The affected events include the Airbourne Eastbourne International Airshow on 14 and 15 August, a flypast at the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo on 15 August, and Lyme Regis Lifeboat Week on 16 August. Wing Commander Sasha Nash, Officer Commanding the RAF Aerobatic Team, stated that safety remains the sole factor determining when the team can begin its journey home from Canada.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — Why the Red Arrows can’t simply fly home from Canada News

facts.claim: The Red Arrows cancelled three UK appearances after becoming stranded in Goose Bay, Labrador due to poor weather delaying their return from North America.
facts.sourceQuote: The Red Arrows have cancelled three UK appearances after becoming stranded in Goose Bay, Labrador, where poor weather has delayed the team’s return from North America.

facts.claim: The cancelled appearances include the Airbourne Eastbourne International Airshow on August 14 and 15, a flypast at the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo on August 15, and Lyme Regis RNLI Lifeboat Week on August 16.
facts.sourceQuote: The team had been due to display at Airbourne Eastbourne International Airshow on 14 and 15 August, take part in a flypast at the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo on 15 August and appear at Lyme Regis RNLI Lifeboat Week on 16 August.

facts.claim: The Red Arrows' BAE Hawk T1 aircraft have limited range and cannot be refuelled in the air.
facts.sourceQuote: Unlike long-range airliners or larger military aircraft, the Red Arrows’ BAE Hawk T1 aircraft have limited range and cannot be refuelled in the air.

facts.claim: Wing Commander Sasha Nash stated that safety is the only factor determining the timing of the team's return from Canada.
facts.sourceQuote: However, safety is the only factor that will determine the timing of the team’s return from Canada.
